newsitem.title: USA: Base Ten names Adelson vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Base Ten names Adelson vice chairman.

text.p: Base Ten Systems Inc said Tuesday that it has named Alex Adelson as vice chairman. Adelson has been a member of Base Ten's board of directors since 1992 and was a co-founder of Symbol Technologies Inc, a supplier of bar-code scanning devices.
The company also announced the election of David Batten to its board of directors. Most recently, Mr. Batten was a general partner at Lazard Freres & Co.
Base Ten is a diversified technology company concentrating on safety critical products in manufacturing execution systems, medical imaging software and weapons control systems.
